import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data from the CSV file
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Plot the distribution of transaction types
transaction_type_counts = data['transaction_type'].value_counts()
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.barplot(x=transaction_type_counts.index, y=transaction_type_counts.values)
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Types')
plt.legend(title='Transaction Type')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot the distribution of hour of day for fraudulent transactions
fraudulent_transactions = data[data['is_fraud'] == 1]['hour_of_day']
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.kdeplot(fraudulent_transactions, shade=True)
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Density')
plt.title('Distribution of Hour of Day for Fraudulent Transactions')
plt.axvline(x=fraudulent_transactions.mean(), color='r', linestyle='--', label='Mean Hour of Day')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_hour_of_day.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot a scatter plot of amount vs hour of day for non-fraudulent transactions
non_fraudulent_transactions = data[data['is_fraud'] == 0][['amount', 'hour_of_day']]
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='hour_of_day', y='amount', data=non_fraudulent_transactions)
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Amount')
plt.title('Amount vs Hour of Day for Non-Fraudulent Transactions')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_amount_hour.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
